title: Slotted Dataclass Memory & Invariant Architecture

claims.assertion: Using slots=True on Python 3.10+ dataclasses eliminates __dict__ memory overhead and reduces per-instance memory footprint by 60-75%.
Mutable default arguments in dataclasses cause shared cross-instance reference leaks unless default_factory is used.
Value objects must combine frozen=True with deterministic __hash__() and validate construction invariants in __post_init__.

context: Knowledge item ki_self_20260828_02: Slotted Dataclass Memory & Invariant Architecture
distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
High-volume internal entity and AST data structures must use `slots=True` to minimize memory footprint, `frozen=True` for immutable value objects, `__post_init__` construction assertions, and `default_factory` for mutable collections.
